items.title: Choosing the right network architecture for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: As enterprises move AI agents from pilot to production, networking often decides whether a deployment scales. This post compares two Amazon Bedrock AgentCore options for reaching private resources in your VPCs: AgentCore runtime VPC support and AgentCore Gateway with VPC Lattice, and shows how each scales with your access patterns and accounts.
items.creator: Daniel Neri
